cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you cut the ribbon, whose bridge is this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And who stopped it leaning into the river?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did. We thanked the engineers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Could one engineer have a name?

mechanism: A corrects public recognition of bridge work through exact distinctions in technical responsibility, becoming more strained until a named individual is acknowledged.
confusable: Simple vanity lacks substantive correction of what work actually made the structure viable.
comparison: Wedding alternative contests attribution to food instead of a person; this one distinguishes civic sponsorship from engineering.
seedUse: Bridge seed supplies collective credit and unnamed engineer; S03 makes the contribution comparison technically specific.
